channel.name: BBC One NL
channel.title: Garden Rescue
channel.desc: Chris and Diarmuid are in Oxford to help Adam, Vaneesha and her father, Graham, transform their two triangular, mirror-image gardens, each with a patio and a solitary shed, into a family-friendly space.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Earth's Seasonal Secrets
channel.desc: We celebrate the glorious nature of Summer on planet Earth, and the extraordinary ways animals and plants rise to the challenges it brings. With the sun shining and the flowers blooming, this is the season of splendid abundance, and the long hours of daylight make life burst out in a riot of activity. But you have to find clever ways to get your share of the good times while they last and as temperatures soar, everything has to deal with sweltering heat.
